subject: reasoning
question: EQ 9 is related to HL −4 in a certain way. In the same way, MR 13 is related to PM 0. To which of the following is MU 19 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, EQ 9 is related to HL −4

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5fe6f2ac5e1e499391f16b2f0aa2f22379031a92cefd2c074526aa042c80823.png] 

For, MR 13 is related to PM 0

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2697c2298388a46413f8140f4364570127f57ef659d7e9c5feb14c03ee1f26ec.png] 

Similarly, for MU 19

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6081816bde6d039954f3962e6c1978f8d78a60d76b7bc8d863271890fccd4607.png] 

So, **MU 19** will be related to **PP 6.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
